messages:
sam: Quick q  who wants to do a retro-arcade vs projector couch-coop night this Friday? thinking CRT cabinet + projector for big-screen classics. low-fi, BYO controller or use mine.

rachel: in! CRT sounds nostalgic. i'll bring a HDMI-to-analog adapter and a handful of extra controllers.

diego: projector or CRT? both? i'm happy to lug the projector but need help with HDMI adapters.

maya: i'll bring extra power strips and a surge protector. can we please not run cords across the kitchenette this time.

gabe: i'm down for Smash, but also up for some GoldenEye rounds for nostalgia. keep it casual.

sam: plan: mezzanine 6pm-11pm? can someone check availability?

facilities-bot: Mezzanine availability: Requested 6:30pm-11pm. Conflict: none. Reservation OK pending headcount.

sam: updated: 6:30pm start. i'll pin a sign on the door.

rachel: poll: pizza or make-your-own? also toppings.

poll-bot: POLL by rachel  "Food: pizza or potluck?" Options: "Order pizza", "Potluck". Votes: Sam (Order pizza), Rachel (Order pizza), Diego (Potluck), Maya (Order pizza), Gabe (Order pizza).

rachel: pizza wins. topping poll incoming.

poll-bot: POLL by rachel  "Toppings" Options: "Cheese", "Pepperoni", "Veggie". Votes: Rachel (Veggie), Diego (Pepperoni), Maya (Cheese), Gabe (Pepperoni), Sam (Cheese).

maya: housekeeping: please label controllers and chargers. last time we swapped PS and Switch dongles.

sam: tech note for projector folks: bring an HDMI switch if you have more than one source. simple script for quick HDMI test:

```
# projector quick test
1) plug hdmi -> projector
2) power on projector
3) set input to HDMI1
4) test video with laptop or dock
```

rachel: i'll tape an adapter kit bag to my backpack so folks can borrow.

diego: travel router? we might need to host a tiny local server for match pairing. anyone have one?

maya: i can bring my travel router + short config notes.

```
# travel-router quick notes
- set to router mode
- enable dhcp
- optional: set ssid "RedwoodLAN"
- don't bridge to production VLAN
```

gabe: prize idea: small stash of retro stickers + a mystery Steam key for the tournament winner. one-key-per-person rule. remote folks get two raffle entries.

sam: remote folks: we'll stream the projector feed and run a remote raffle via this channel. remote players can join parlay for spectating.

rachel: logistics: i'll create a tiny sign-up sheet and a simple bracket for Smash/GoldenEye. link pinned later.

maya: noise rule: please keep speakers on low after 10:30pm. we have neighbors.

sam: agreed. also please return all chairs and wipe the table after.

diego: curious: anyone bringing a CRT joystick adapter? old controllers might need a DB9/adapter.

rachel: i have one DB9-to-USB adapter. will bring. label it.

gabe: final q: cosplay/silly hat bonus for earliest arrival? tiny prize?

sam: yes silly hats get first pick of mystery keys. :tophat:

facilities-bot: Reminder: please do not move server racks. Keep cables tidy and report any spills to facilities immediately.

sam: ok were set. sheet + bracket link will go up tomorrow. see y'all Friday!
